answer: Every claim climbs the ridge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the glacier re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the umber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
